_notes: Southern Barrens boss + named-rare loot (2026-10-21). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

General Twinbraid.name: Twinbraid's Stormhammer
General Twinbraid.flavor_text: A hammer built to be thrown and caught. The dwarf who built it did not account for a general's temper.

General Twinbraid.name: General's Braided-Beard Cuirass
General Twinbraid.flavor_text: Plate in the old Bael'dun style, with a braided beard-pattern in the rivets. It smells of oil and fury.

General Twinbraid.name: Bulwark of Bael'dun
General Twinbraid.flavor_text: A tower shield with the keep's sigil beaten flat by many years of the wrong kind of visitor.

General Twinbraid.name: Quartermaster's Iron Girdle
General Twinbraid.flavor_text: A heavy belt hung with brass keys. None of them open anything in the Barrens.

Hagg Taurenbane.name: Hagg's Taurenbane Hatchet
Hagg Taurenbane.flavor_text: A short axe with notches filed in the haft. Hagg stopped counting at forty.

Hagg Taurenbane.name: Trophy-Hunter's Hide Vest
Hagg Taurenbane.flavor_text: Hung with horn-tips and braided hair. The horn-tips are sorted by size. The hair is not.

Hagg Taurenbane.name: Gauntlets of the Ridge-Stalker
Hagg Taurenbane.flavor_text: Thorn-wood knuckle plates over mail. Punching with them is not strictly advisable.

Hagg Taurenbane.name: Taurenbane's Bone Signet
Hagg Taurenbane.flavor_text: A ring cut from a bull-horn tip. It's warm. It is not meant to be.

Brontus.name: Brontus's Horn-Hewn Greatclub
Brontus.flavor_text: Cut from a single giant horn. Heavy enough to flatten a quilboar and everything behind him.

Brontus.name: Earthshaker Greaves
Brontus.flavor_text: Plate over kodo-hide. Every step feels like you're about to stampede.

Brontus.name: Pendant of the Thunderhoof
Brontus.flavor_text: A bull's horn-tip set in iron. It rings, very softly, whenever the ground does.

Brontus.name: Stampede-Hide Girdle
Brontus.flavor_text: Pale kodo-hide, tanned until it creaks like a drum. Hits to the ribs sound like thunder.

Dustmaw the Rift-Lurker.name: Dustmaw's Canyon-Fang
Dustmaw the Rift-Lurker.flavor_text: A tooth the length of a dagger, still gritty with canyon dust.

Dustmaw the Rift-Lurker.name: Rift-Runner's Boots
Dustmaw the Rift-Lurker.flavor_text: Soft hide, ribbed soles. Climbing a wall in these feels like cheating, because it is.

Dustmaw the Rift-Lurker.name: Gravel-Ground Signet
Dustmaw the Rift-Lurker.flavor_text: A band of rock-crystal. It rattles faintly when something's about to fall.

Thrumbone the Ancient.name: Thrumbone's Marrow Staff
Thrumbone the Ancient.flavor_text: A giant's thigh-bone, hollow and very old. Wind whistles through it in a language nobody speaks.

Thrumbone the Ancient.name: Robes of the Rattling Dirge
Thrumbone the Ancient.flavor_text: Cloth stitched with knucklebones. They click in time with your heartbeat. Mostly.

Thrumbone the Ancient.name: Giantbone Charm of Mending
Thrumbone the Ancient.flavor_text: A tiny carved finger-bone on a cord. Wearing it, wounds seem to take less offence.

Old Mother Longhorn.name: Matriarch's Horn-Plate Pauldrons
Old Mother Longhorn.flavor_text: Layered kodo horn over iron. They do the same job she did: stand in front of the herd.

Old Mother Longhorn.name: Herd-Mother's Gavel
Old Mother Longhorn.flavor_text: A short-handled mace carved from a horn-tip. It rings like a gong.

Old Mother Longhorn.name: Band of the Last Calf
Old Mother Longhorn.flavor_text: A ring of small, old horn. Don't ask what it's from.

Bramblequeen Durga.name: Durga's Briar-Crowned Staff
Bramblequeen Durga.flavor_text: A staff grown, not carved. It keeps growing, if you don't mind the thorns.

Bramblequeen Durga.name: Hood of the Bramble Court
Bramblequeen Durga.flavor_text: A cowl woven from thorn-vine. It gives you a headache and good ideas, in that order.

Bramblequeen Durga.name: Briar-Binder's Bracers
Bramblequeen Durga.flavor_text: Mail over bramble-cord. The thorns point inward, so it hurts to take them off.

Skinwalker Garn.name: Garn's Flaying Knife
Skinwalker Garn.flavor_text: The blade is shaped like a leaf. The handle is wrapped in a stranger's hair.

Skinwalker Garn.name: Skin-Stitched Leggings
Skinwalker Garn.flavor_text: Stitched from several different animals. One of them used to be a person. Probably.

Skinwalker Garn.name: Charm of Many Hides
Skinwalker Garn.flavor_text: A pouch of small animal teeth. It rattles when you're about to be noticed.

Foreman Grubb Deepdelver.name: Grubb's Deepdelver Pickaxe
Foreman Grubb Deepdelver.flavor_text: A heavy iron pickaxe, balanced for one-handed swings and two-handed regrets.

Foreman Grubb Deepdelver.name: Foreman's Hard-Hat Helm
Foreman Grubb Deepdelver.flavor_text: An iron cap with a lantern bracket. The bracket's been dented by every ceiling in the quarry.

Foreman Grubb Deepdelver.name: Quota-Keeper's Utility Belt
Foreman Grubb Deepdelver.flavor_text: Loops for every tool, and a pocket for the paperwork nobody wanted to read.

Sergeant Ironvein.name: Ironvein's Rampart
Sergeant Ironvein.flavor_text: A kite shield in dwarven steel. The dent at the top is where a general threw something.

Sergeant Ironvein.name: Keep-Marcher's Sabatons
Sergeant Ironvein.flavor_text: Steel boots with studs. They announce you from three rooms away.

Sergeant Ironvein.name: Signet of the Iron Vein
Sergeant Ironvein.flavor_text: A band of dark ore with a bright vein through it, like a scar.

Razorbeak the Nestbreaker.name: Razorbeak's Raptorbone Bow
Razorbeak the Nestbreaker.flavor_text: Strung with raptor sinew. It twangs like something remembering how to hunt.

Razorbeak the Nestbreaker.name: Nestbreaker's Scale Jerkin
Razorbeak the Nestbreaker.flavor_text: Overlapping raptor scales over soft hide. It sheds sand, and rumours.

Razorbeak the Nestbreaker.name: Cloak of the Stolen Egg
Razorbeak the Nestbreaker.flavor_text: Feathered and speckled. Smells distinctly like omelette.

Vexa the Tunnel-Queen.name: Vexa's Brood-Scepter
Vexa the Tunnel-Queen.flavor_text: A scepter of fused chitin with a soft, pulsing grub-sac at the tip. Do not squeeze it. It knows.

Vexa the Tunnel-Queen.name: Tunnel-Queen's Chitin Cowl
Vexa the Tunnel-Queen.flavor_text: Plates of hard shell, sewn with sinew. The cavities hold amber. The amber holds something.

Vexa the Tunnel-Queen.name: Hive-Amber Band
Vexa the Tunnel-Queen.flavor_text: A hard bead of resin, warm to the touch. Something small inside kicks, once, whenever you heal.

Skyshriek Matron.name: Skyshriek's Storm-Feather Wand
Skyshriek Matron.flavor_text: A wand with a harpy feather at the tip. The feather crackles when it's thinking.

Skyshriek Matron.name: Matron's Feathered Mantle
Skyshriek Matron.flavor_text: Feather-light, thunder-bright. It makes your hair do things.

Skyshriek Matron.name: Windspire Matron's Ring
Skyshriek Matron.flavor_text: A ring of wind-polished sandstone. The wind only blows from one direction here: toward you.
